hints.title: Greedy Placement Priority
hints.text: A food bucket placed to the right of an unfed hamster can potentially satisfy an adjacent hamster to its right as well.

hints.title: Cover Verification
hints.text: Before adding a bucket for a hamster, check whether it is already covered by a bucket placed on its left.

hints.title: Fallback and Impossibility
hints.text: If the right cell is not available, try placing the bucket on the left. If neither is empty, feeding all hamsters is impossible.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of hamsters street string
complexity.notes: Greedily placing food buckets to the right feeds the current hamster and potentially the next one.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Placing buckets arbitrarily or without looking ahead leads to redundant bucket placement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the position of the latest placed bucket requires constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that rightward bucket placement is strictly optimal.
